card.name: Word before a table's action or category
card.fires_on: Fires on a word just before a key term in tables or lists, most clearly "Any" after "Grade 3 or 4" ahead of "Permanently discontinue". It also appears on a few partway-through-word spots in drug names and on short linking words.
